import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# 1. Load data
clinical = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', low_memory=False)
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', low_memory=False)

# 2. Annotate clinical groups: rename patient ID column to 'patient_id'
col = 'subsequent_primary_melanoma_during_followup'
clinical = clinical[['bcr_patient_barcode', col]].rename(
    columns={'bcr_patient_barcode': 'patient_id'}
)
clinical = clinical.dropna(subset=[col])
clinical = clinical[clinical[col].isin(['YES', 'NO'])]

# 3. Prepare mutations: use provided patient_id and filter SNVs
snv = mut[mut['Variant_Type'] == 'SNP'].copy()

# 4. Count SNVs and C>T transitions
# Assume columns 'Reference_Allele' and 'Tumor_Seq_Allele2' exist
snv = snv.rename(columns={'Reference_Allele': 'ref', 'Tumor_Seq_Allele2': 'alt'})
totals = snv.groupby('patient_id').size().rename('total_snvs')
ct = snv[(snv['ref'] == 'C') & (snv['alt'] == 'T')].groupby('patient_id').size().rename('ct_count')
counts = pd.concat([totals, ct], axis=1).fillna(0)
counts['ct_prop'] = counts['ct_count'] / counts['total_snvs']
counts = counts.reset_index()

# 5. Merge with clinical annotation
df = clinical.merge(counts, on='patient_id', how='inner')

# 6. Summary statistics of C>T proportions by group
summary = df.groupby(col)['ct_prop'].agg(
    median='median',
    q1=lambda x: x.quantile(0.25),
    q3=lambda x: x.quantile(0.75)
)
print("C>T proportion summary by group:\n", summary, "\n")

# 7. Mann-Whitney U test
g_yes = df.loc[df[col] == 'YES', 'ct_prop']
g_no = df.loc[df[col] == 'NO', 'ct_prop']
stat, pval = mannwhitneyu(g_yes, g_no, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"Mann-Whitney U test: U={stat:.2f}, p-value={pval:.4f}\n")

# 8. Linear regression adjusting for TMB
df['log_tmb'] = np.log2(df['total_snvs'] + 1)
model = smf.ols('ct_prop ~ log_tmb + C(%s)' % col, data=df).fit()
print(model.summary())

# 9. Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
sns.boxplot(x=col, y='ct_prop', data=df, palette='Set2')
plt.ylabel('Proportion of C>T transitions')
plt.xlabel('Multiple primary melanoma during follow-up')
plt.title('C>T Proportion by Group')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

g_yes = df.loc[df[col] == 'YES', 'ct_prop']
g_no = df.loc[df[col] == 'NO', 'ct_prop']
stat, pval = mannwhitneyu(g_yes, g_no, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"Mann-Whitney U test: U={stat:.2f}, p-value={pval:.4f}\n")

# 8. Linear regression adjusting for TMB
df['log_tmb'] = np.log2(df['total_snvs'] + 1)
model = smf.ols('ct_prop ~ log_tmb + C(%s)' % col, data=df).fit()
print(model.summary())

# 9. Visualization

sns.boxplot(x=col, y='ct_prop', data=df, palette='Set2')
plt.ylabel('Proportion of C>T transitions')
plt.xlabel('Multiple primary melanoma during follow-up')
plt.title('C>T Proportion by Group')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
